restrictedCapabilities.runFullTrust: Streamer-Assist is an Electron/Node.js Win32 app packaged as MSIX. runFullTrust is required for its desktop process, system tray, global timeline shortcuts, local chat/donation storage, user-selected exports, and optional AI CLI child processes. It runs with standard user privileges, without elevation. AI runs only on user request, components are stored in the app's user-data folder, and startup is disabled by default.
